HI – Kukio Blue Water Swim

The Kukio Blue Water Sim will occur on Saturday, September 19th, 2026 from 0800-1030. The swim will be a water start at Kua Bay (Maniniowali Beach), swim 1.2 miles to Uluweuweu Bay and finish by running up the finishing chute at Kukio Beach.

Mariners are advised to maintain a sharp navigational watch, keep well clear of all participants and safety vessels, and transit the area at a slow, no-wake speed.
